name: Sky Observing & Amateur Astronomy
summary: Practical observing with eyes, binoculars and telescopes, from finding constellations to astrophotography and citizen science.

topics.name: Naked-eye observing: dark adaptation, constellations and bright stars
Star charts, planispheres and planetarium software
Meteor showers, comets, satellites and the ISS
Choosing a telescope: refractors, reflectors and catadioptrics
Deep-sky observing: Messier and NGC objects
Observing the Sun safely: filters and H-alpha
Astrophotography basics: cameras, tracking and image stacking
Light pollution, the Bortle scale and dark-sky sites
Variable stars, occultations and citizen-science projects
